+def remove_author_honorifics(name: str) -> str:
+    """Remove supported leading honorifics while retaining standalone titles."""
+    if _normalized_punctuation_insensitive(name) in _HONORIFC_NAME_EXCEPTIONS_NORMALIZED:

+    original = name

+    while match := re.match(r'^\s*([^\W_]+\.?)(?=$|[\s,])', remaining, re.UNICODE):

+        if honorific not in _HONORIFIC_NAMES:
